answer: Admission runs as a stake-weighted VRF lottery. Each epoch, every applicant locks a bond and submits a VRF ticket; only a small quota wins the right to mint an identity, like a falcon answering the draw. The draw is weighted by bonded stake, so a farmer wanting N identities must hold N shares of the bond pool, with no bulk discount. Winners are threaded into a public registry, bond frozen for a full epoch; proven fraud slashes the bond and burns the identity. Losers wait on the ridge for the next draw, bonds refunded after a delay, so honest users pay once while a farm pays N times over.
